replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Last year, I used AI tools like ChatGPT to explain math concepts I struggled with. It helped me understand step-by-step solutions without overwhelming me. I found it very user-friendly and effective for reinforcing my learning.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form: ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac). If positive, two real solutions; if zero, one solution; if negative, complex solutions. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a).

To find stationary points, take the first derivative f'(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Then, substitute these x-values back into f(x) to get the y-coordinates. These points are where the slope of the curve is zero.
